categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the Tests label, modifies test_runner.py, and introduces a functional test exercising node crash recovery.
categories.rationale: Adds a fast, deterministic functional test for chainstate block replay to default PR CI, catching realistic crash-recovery regressions in validation. Recovery is currently only covered by feature_dbcrash.py in extended scripts that 'never runs on PRs', while this test runs in ~1s and catches mutant off-by-one errors demonstrated in validation.cpp rollback and roll-forward loops.
